crossRefs.note: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
So they both went until they came to Bethlehem. When they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was excited about them…
Samuel did that which Yahweh spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said…
His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these…
Who is this who comes up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all…
Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching…
The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this that speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but…
Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.
They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”
The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”
translations.bsb: When Jesus had entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”
translations.kjv: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
